preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.intro: How Polaris looks for your account, and the units and formats it writes in.

language.title: Language
language.hint: Applies right away, in every open tab.

theme.label: Theme
theme.hint: Applied the moment it is saved, on every screen.

descriptions.dark: The default. Quiet surfaces with a trace of blue in them.
descriptions.light: White surfaces, for a bright room.
descriptions.system: Dark or light, whichever this machine is set to.
descriptions.midnight: Nearly black, with the panels further apart. For a dark room.
descriptions.graphite: Grey with no colour cast, for anyone the blue tint bothers.

weekStart.label: Week starts on
weekStart.hint: Where every calendar and week view begins.

timeZone.label: Time zone
timeZone.hint: Every time on screen is written in it. Automatic follows the device you are on.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Polaris is laid out in this size, so the rows and panels around the text grow with it. The page changes as you move the slider; it stays that way once you save.
accessibility.defaultIs: The default here is {size}px. <back>Go back to it</back>

spoilers.title: Show spoilers without asking
spoilers.body: Pictures and messages somebody sent covered are drawn straight away instead of waiting for a press. This browser only.

deviceCache.title: This device
deviceCache.body: Polaris keeps a few things in this browser so screens open faster - pictures, how loud each person is in a call, playback speed. Clear them if something looks out of date and a reload has not fixed it. Your other devices are not affected, and you stay signed in.

apps.title: Polaris as an app
apps.body: Open Polaris in its own window, install the desktop app, or add the browser extension.

errors.statusNotSaved: That status could not be saved

page.title: Access rules
page.intro: Restrict where your account and your API keys may be used from.

summary.addresses: {count, plural, one {# address rule} other {# address rules}}

access.deleteInUse: It is in use; the rules it contributes will stop applying.

signIn.title: Sign-in restrictions
signIn.description: Leave everything empty to allow sign-in from anywhere. Otherwise a sign-in must match your address rules and your allowed locations.
signIn.none: No restriction: your account can be signed in from any address.

access.enforced: An administrator also limits this account to {rules}.

groups.title: Access groups
groups.description: Named rule sets you can attach to your sign-ins and to API keys.
groups.empty: No groups yet. Create one to reuse the same allowlist in more than one place.
groups.dialogDescription: A named set of addresses and locations you can reuse anywhere access is restricted.

errors.lockout: That would block the address you are using right now. Add it to the rules first, or leave them empty.

page.title: Activity
page.intro: What has been done with your account, and which device did it.

activity.emptySession: Nothing recorded from this session yet.

page.title: API keys
page.intro: Credentials for scripts and integrations acting as you. Keep them somewhere safe: anyone holding one can do what it allows, as you.

limits.addresses: {count, plural, one {# address rule} other {# address rules}}
limits.allowed: {count, plural, one {# allowed client} other {# allowed clients}}
limits.blocked: {count, plural, one {# blocked client} other {# blocked clients}}

list.scopesLimited: {count, plural, one {# scope} other {# scopes}} - limited to {limits}
list.revokeDescription: Anything using this key stops working immediately.
list.deleteDescription: The key disappears from this list. It cannot be undone.
list.emptyHint: A key lets a script act as you, with a subset of your own permissions and only from where you allow.

form.copyNow: Copy it now. Polaris stores only a hash of it and cannot show it again - losing it means making another key.
form.editIntro: Everything except the secret itself. Whatever is using this key keeps working.
form.newIntro: A key acts as you, with a subset of your own permissions and only from where you allow.

what.title: What it is
what.hint: How you will recognise this key in a year.

form.descriptionPlaceholder: What this key is for, and what would break without it.
form.environmentHint: The environment is a label for sorting your own keys. Both reach the same Polaris.
form.expiryHint: A key that never expires is a key nobody ever reviews.
form.endOfDay: Works through the end of the chosen day.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.hint: A key can never do more than you can, whatever is ticked here.

where.title: Where it may be used
where.hint: Addresses and places the key is answered from. Left empty, it works from anywhere you do.

clients.title: What may use it
clients.hint: The clients allowed to present it. A blocked one is refused whatever the allow list says.

form.noneHeld: You do not hold any of the permissions you picked.

scopes.noneHeld: You hold no permissions a key could carry.

page.title: Connected accounts
page.intro: The outside accounts Polaris acts with on your behalf. Only yours, and only what you link.

outcomes.stateError: That request did not come from this page. Start it again.
outcomes.taken: That account is already linked to another Polaris account.
outcomes.limit: You have already linked as many accounts of that service as you are allowed.
outcomes.unavailable: This Polaris cannot connect that service yet.
outcomes.error: The service did not complete the authorization. Nothing was wrong on your side: this Polaris has told its administrators.

badges.notGranted: Not granted: {scopes}. Connect again to approve.
badges.connectAgain: Connect again to approve what Polaris now asks for.
badges.signsInTitle: This account can sign you in
badges.tokenTitle: Connected with a personal access token
badges.notVerifiedTitle: You typed this name. Nothing has confirmed the account is yours.

connections.reconnectToApprove: Reconnect {account} to approve what Polaris now asks for
connections.canSignIn: An account you connect can also sign you in - choose which under <link>Security</link>.
connections.useReconnect: To approve what Polaris now asks for, use the reconnect button beside the account above.
connections.disconnectOne: Disconnect one to connect another account.
connections.availableOnce: Available once whoever administers this Polaris connects {requires} under Integrations.

disconnectDialog.manual: Servers stop being able to add you by this name until you type it again or connect your account.
disconnectDialog.github: Polaris stops reaching anything in this {provider} account. Services that build from its repositories stop deploying, and any runner pool serving you stops serving them.
disconnectDialog.signsIn: Polaris stops reaching anything in this {provider} account. It also stops being a way to sign in to Polaris.
disconnectDialog.other: Polaris stops reaching anything in this {provider} account.
disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect {account}?

aws.title: Connect AWS with an access key
aws.description: Polaris asks AWS who the key belongs to and connects that account. It reads your ECS services and Amplify branches in this region, and can ask for another release.
aws.regionHint: The one your services are in. A key reaches every region; what it can see is decided here, and the wrong one simply lists nothing.

minecraft.description: Exactly as it appears in the game, with the same upper and lower case. A typed name is shown as not verified.
minecraft.hint: Java Edition: 3 to 16 letters, numbers or underscores.

token.title: Connect {provider} with a token
token.description: Polaris checks the token with {provider} and connects whichever account it belongs to.

errors.noToken: That service cannot be connected with a token
errors.notAccessKey: That does not look like an access key
errors.notSecretKey: That does not look like a secret key
errors.nameRegion: Name the region your services are in
errors.checkDetails: Check the details and try again
errors.checkUsername: Check the username and try again
errors.usernameNotSaved: Could not save the username. Try again.
errors.notLinked: That account is not linked to your profile

page.title: Account
page.intro: How you sign in and how Polaris reaches you. None of it is on your profile.

details.title: About you
details.description: What sits beside your name on your page, and where else you can be found.
details.headline: Headline
details.headlineHint: One line, under your name. What you do, not your life story - the paragraph goes in the description above.
details.pronounsHint: Drawn beside your name. Nothing is drawn when you have not said.

links.title: Links
links.name: Link {number} name
links.hint: A portfolio, a site, a linktree. Typing the site is enough - https:// is added for you - and an address with no name is drawn as its own host.

problems.invalid: That is not a web address
problems.noSite: That address has no site in it

name.title: Your name
name.description: Held on the account. Not what other people see, unless you say so in Privacy.

page.title: Voice & Video
page.intro: Which microphone and camera Polaris uses on this machine, and how you sound through them. Kept in this browser, because a headset is plugged into a machine rather than into an account.

mic.title: Microphone
mic.pressTest: Press Test it to see what is here
mic.namesHint: The names only appear once a microphone has been allowed once, which the test does.
mic.saySomething: Say something. The bars should move.
mic.watchBars: Talk and watch the bars. If they stay dark, press Test it.
mic.unfiltered: It could not start, so you are going out unfiltered: {problem}
mic.runningNoModel: Running, with no model - only the volume above.
mic.volumeHint: How loud you go out. Turn it up if people say you are quiet.

camera.title: Camera
camera.pressShow: Press Show me to see what is here
camera.closed: Nothing is opened until you press it, and it closes when you leave this screen.
camera.inCall: This is the camera your call is sending, background and all.
camera.ownPicture: Use a picture of your own
camera.pictureStays: A picture of your own stays in this browser and is sent nowhere.
camera.pictureFailed: Polaris could not use that picture.
camera.starting: Starting. The first one on a machine downloads the model.
camera.failed: It could not start, so there is nothing behind you: {problem}
camera.running: Running. This is what a call sends.

input.title: Input
input.keyHint: Held down to talk. It stands down while you are typing.
input.thresholdHint: Test the microphone above while you set this: the mark on the bar is where it opens, and the bar turns green past it.
input.releaseHint: Zero cuts the last syllable off, and everybody hears it.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.intro: Leave these alone unless something is wrong. Each one is set to what Polaris did before this screen existed.

autoGain.label: Automatic gain control
autoGain.note: Lets the browser even out how loud you are. Turn it off if your level is pumped up and down between sentences.

betterDetection.label: Better voice detection
betterDetection.note: Decides whether you are talking from the cleaned-up sound rather than the raw microphone, so a keyboard or a fan does not open it. Costs whatever the noise model costs.

bypass.label: Send the microphone untouched
bypass.note: Turns off the browser's echo, noise and level handling together, for an interface or a feed that has already done all three. Doing it twice is what ruins that sound.

noAudio.label: Say when nothing is picked up
noAudio.note: A microphone that opened but hears nothing looks exactly like somebody who is not talking. This is the only thing that would tell you.

switchWarning.label: Ask before switching rooms mid-call
switchWarning.note: Joining another voice room hangs up the call you are in. Off by default, because most of the time that is what pressing it meant.

attenuate.label: Quieten the call while you talk
attenuate.note: Turns the room down while your microphone is open. It is Polaris's own sound, not the machine's - a page cannot reach your other applications.

advanced.howFarLabel: How far the call is quietened
advanced.howFarHint: A hundred is silence while you are speaking.
advanced.stream: Lower voices while a stream plays
advanced.streamLabel: How far voices are lowered while a stream plays
advanced.streamHint: While you watch a stream that has sound. Zero leaves voices alone.

page.title: Domains
page.intro: Domains you own, so what you deploy here answers on your own name instead of this Polaris’s.

page.title: Connect the extension
page.intro: Type the code the extension is showing. Nothing is connected until you say so.

extension.connectedHint: The extension has what it needs. You can close this page - it appears under Sessions, and you can end it there.
extension.consent: Saying yes lets this extension act for your account until you end it from Sessions. It does not open your vault: letting it into one is a second decision, made in the vault.
extension.codeLabel: The code the extension is showing

errors.tooMany: Too many codes tried. Wait a few minutes.
errors.notACode: That is not a code from the Polaris extension.
errors.nothingWaiting: Nothing is waiting on that code. Ask the extension for a new one.

page.title: Friends
page.intro: Who sees what you show your friends. Being friends grants nothing else.

friends.removeDescription: They keep whatever else reaches them - a shared space, a conversation - and lose only what you show your friends. Either of you can ask again.
friends.empty: Nobody yet. Until there is, "friends only" is the same as "nobody".
friends.hint: Somebody who keeps themselves out of the search can still be asked, if they have given you their exact username.

page.title: Scan a code
page.intro: Let a sign-in through on a device that cannot ask for your password.

errors.notACode: That is not a Polaris sign-in code.

scan.cameraUnavailable: The camera is not available here. Browsers only allow it over a secure (https) address - type the code instead.
scan.stale: That code is no longer valid. Ask for a new one on the sign-in screen and scan it again.
scan.typeCode: Or type the code under the QR
scan.approved: That device is signed in. It may take a moment to move on.
scan.askNew: Ask for a new one on the sign-in screen and scan it again.

decide.title: Allow this sign-in?
decide.description: It gets in as you. Allow it only if it is you at that screen.
decide.needsPin: Allowing a sign-in this way needs a quick unlock PIN. <link>Set one in Security</link>, then scan the code again.

history.title: Codes you have answered
history.description: Each one signed a device in as you, or turned it away.
history.empty: You have not answered a sign-in code yet.
history.readOnGone: Read on a device that is no longer signed in

page.title: Account standing
page.intro: Where your account stands here, and anything in force against it.

notes.good: Nothing has been upheld against your account. If a moderator ever takes something of yours down, it shows up here.
notes.limited: One thing you posted was taken down after somebody reported it.
notes.veryLimited: Two things you posted were taken down after somebody reported them.
notes.atRisk: Several things you posted have been taken down after being reported. Another may cost you the account.
notes.suspended: This account has been suspended and cannot sign in.

standing.countedSince: Counted since {date}. Older decisions no longer count.

inForce.title: In force now
inForce.description: A timeout ends by itself. A ban is lifted by whoever runs that space.
inForce.none: Nothing. You can post everywhere you are a member.

games.title: Game server sanctions
games.description: What a game server's moderators or anti-cheat decided about a player linked to your account. It is that server's decision, not Polaris's, and does not change your standing here.
games.none: Nothing. No game server has sanctioned a player linked to your account.
games.incomplete: Some game servers could not be read just now. Reload the page to try again.

page.title: Profile
page.intro: How you appear to everybody else in Polaris.

profile.cardDescription: Your name, your username, and what your page says.
profile.displayNameHint: Shown wherever your name appears. It does not have to be your name.
profile.usernameLocked: Other people find and address you by this, so it can only be changed once in a while. You can change it again in {when}.
profile.aboutHint: Shown to anybody who opens your profile.
profile.usernameHint: 3-30 characters: letters, numbers, - or _. Used to sign in.

errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Try again in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
errors.tooManyChecks: Too many checks. Wait a moment.
errors.addressGone: That address is no longer on your account.

errors.reopen: Could not open that picture again
errors.animated: A moving picture cannot be reframed - replace it to change how it sits

pictures.reframeNote: Move and scale what is already there
pictures.uploadNote: Choose a picture from this device - a GIF keeps moving
pictures.removeNote: Go back to the default {kind, select, banner {banner} other {photo}}
pictures.title: {kind, select, banner {Banner} other {Photo}}
pictures.personHint: How your profile looks to everybody else. Without a photo, Polaris uses the picture your email address has on Gravatar and your initials if it has none; without a banner, a colour taken from your photo.
pictures.orgHint: How this organization looks wherever it appears - the switcher, its people's rosters, and its own page. Without a photo, Polaris draws its initials; without a banner, a colour taken from the photo.

banner.label: Banner
banner.hint: The band across the top of your profile, under your banner picture.
banner.angleLabel: The angle the two colours run at

decoration.label: Avatar decoration
decoration.hint: Drawn on your picture wherever you're introduced - your profile, messages, member lists - not in pickers or tables. Every one of them is free.

nameplate.label: Nameplate
nameplate.hint: Where your name appears in a list of people, like the members of a conversation.

nameStyle.label: Display name style
nameStyle.hint: What the paint does, and in which colours. Nothing here changes the size, so a name is never taller than the row it is in.

font.label: Font
font.hint: The letterforms your display name is set in, wherever it appears. Only downloaded when somebody's name on the screen is actually set in one.

effect.label: Profile effect
effect.hint: An edge, a slow band of light, or both. It stops for anybody who has asked their machine for less motion.

companies.title: Where you work
companies.description: Who sees any of this is one setting on your privacy screen. Nothing here is shown until you tick it.
companies.organizations: Organizations here. These carry a tick on your page: Polaris holds the roster and you are on it.
companies.typedHint: Drawn without a tick, because Polaris knows nothing about these beyond that you typed them.

emails.title: Email addresses
emails.description: The address you sign in with, and any others this account owns.
emails.removeDescription: {email} will no longer be on your account.
emails.noChannel: No email channel is set up, so Polaris cannot send the link.
emails.duplicate: That address is already on your account.
emails.recoveryHint: A recovery address is where an operator can reach you if you lose access.
emails.promoteDescription: You will sign in with {email}. The current one stays on your account.

phone.title: Phone number
phone.description: Confirmed through one of your own WhatsApp channels, which is also what carries a sign-in code when you use one.
phone.setDescription: It starts unconfirmed. Confirm it before it can carry a sign-in code.
phone.removeDescription: Confirm your password. WhatsApp stops being one of your sign-in options.

page.title: AI provider keys
page.intro: The provider accounts your AI work bills to. A key you add here is used before anything the deployment holds.

keys.title: Your provider keys
keys.hint: Tried from the top. The first key whose provider serves the model is the one a run uses.
keys.emptyShared: No keys of your own. Runs use the deployment's.
keys.empty: No keys yet. A run needs one to reach a provider.
keys.adding: The provider account your runs bill to. Polaris adds nothing to that bill.

accounts.title: Your agent accounts
accounts.hint: Tried from the top. The first that signs the agent in is the one a session on this box uses.
accounts.emptyShared: None of your own. Sessions use the ones this deployment provides.
accounts.empty: None yet. A session on this box needs one to sign an agent in.
accounts.adding: The account a session signs an agent in with. A subscription costs nothing extra; an API key is metered.

fallback.title: What a run falls back to
fallback.shared: For a provider you have no key of your own for, runs use the deployment's.
fallback.noKeys: This deployment holds no provider keys, so a run can only use one you add here.
fallback.notShared: This deployment does not share its own provider keys, so a run can only use one you add here.

errors.notAssisted: That is not a sign-in Polaris can run for you.
errors.couldNotStart: Polaris could not start a machine for the sign-in. Try again in a moment.
errors.notOpen: That sign-in is no longer open.

errors.adminOnly: Only an administrator can edit this Polaris's DNS zones
errors.unreadable: That record could not be read

page.title: Downloads
page.intro: Polaris on your desktop, in your browser, and on your own machine.

extension.title: Browser extension
extension.description: Fills a login, saves a new one, and unlocks from your vault. It asks the browser for permission to talk to this Polaris and no other, and holds no standing access to the pages you open.
extension.storeHint: Loading it yourself below keeps it just as current now, so there is no need to wait for the store.
extension.alreadyHave: Already have it? <link>Connect it to this account</link>. Your vault is the second step, from the extension itself.

later.title: Not here yet
later.mobileHint: No app yet. Installing Polaris as an app above puts it on your home screen from the browser, which is most of the way there.
later.cliHint: For managing your things from your own computer, and for opening a tunnel from it to a service here. Nothing to install yet, so there is no command to copy.

command.title: One line, and it keeps itself up to date
command.system: Which system you are installing on
command.hint: Paste it into {shell}. The first time, press Load unpacked and choose the folder it names. After that it checks for a new version every few hours and the extension restarts into it by itself. Firefox is not covered: its temporary add-on is gone when Firefox closes, so there is nothing for a script to keep current.

steps.whichBrowser: Which browser you are loading it into
steps.noBuild: There is no build for the browser you are reading this in. Pick the one you are installing into.
steps.downloadUnpack: Download the <press>{file}</press> file above. Unpack it - what gets loaded is the folder inside, not the .zip.
steps.downloadZipped: Download the <press>{file}</press> file above. Leave it zipped; Firefox takes the .zip as it is.
steps.openPage: Open the extensions page in {browser}. Copy this and paste it into the address bar yourself - no page is allowed to open that address, which is why there is no button here that does it for you.
steps.landOn: You land on <press>{pane}</press>, which is the pane that can load one.
steps.developerMode: Turn on <press>Developer mode</press>, top right. Without it the next button is not there.
steps.pressFolder: Press <press>{action}</press> and choose the unpacked folder.
steps.pressFile: Press <press>{action}</press> and choose the file you downloaded.
steps.pointIt: Open the extension and point it at this Polaris. It asks for permission to talk to this address and no other.
steps.caveatChromium: It stays until you remove it, and it does not update itself. Replacing the files in the same folder and pressing the refresh arrow is how it takes a new version.
steps.caveatFirefox: Temporary is literal: Firefox lets it go when it closes, so it has to be loaded again next time.
